persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make four square Instagram carousel slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily, in that order. One plant and its name per slide. Keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout: same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape. Only the plant and name should change. Send separate slides.
bank.Slide count, order and text: Four separate slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily. Each name is the only copy on its slide.
bank.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
bank.Shared style: Sage-green-and-cream linocut illustration with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide.
bank.What may vary: Only the plant illustration and its name. Keep the surrounding design and pot consistent.

messages.text: I’d like you to make a set of plant slides, and I’m probably over-explaining because I’m worried they’ll end up looking like they belong to different sets. Please keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout, with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide. These should be four square Instagram carousel slides, with Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, and Peace lily in that order. Put one plant and its name on each slide. What I mean by keeping them consistent is that only the plant and its name should change, not any of the surrounding design or the pot. Please send the slides separately.
